# MetaUI published API surface - GENERATED, DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
#
# Regenerate after any change to an exported declaration:
#   npm run build
#   node .github/scripts/api-surface.js dist --out .github/api-surface.txt
#
# Every exported declaration in the nz/co/siliconst namespace appears below, split
# into three tiers. CI fails when this file is stale, so EVERY change - internal
# included - shows up in the diff of the pull request that causes it. What differs
# between the tiers is what the release gate does about it:
#
#   public     Documented in docs/wiki/APIReference.md for applications.
#              GATED: a patch bump must leave it byte-identical, a minor bump may
#              only add to it, a removal or change needs a major bump.
#   extension  Documented in docs/wiki/CreatingPlugins.md and the policy / OpenAPI
#              extension points, for code that plugs INTO MetaUI. GATED, same rules.
#   internal   Exported so the AMD loader and PluginRegistry can reach it. NOT a
#              promise to anyone. REPORTED at release time, never gated: it may
#              change in a patch release.
#
# Tier membership comes from the API_TIERS allowlist in api-surface.js, not from the
# @public JSDoc tag. A new export defaults to `internal`, which is the safe side.
# `@internal` in the JSDoc demotes; nothing in src/ can promote.
#
# `private` members are excluded; `protected` members are kept, because plugin
# authors subclass BasePlugin and friends.

=== tier: public ===

module nz/co/siliconst/ui5/metaui/core/SchemaWalker
  class SchemaWalker
    static resolveScope(schema: ISchema, scope: string, resolveDefinition?: (ref: string) => ISchema | null, activeNodes?: WeakSet<object>, activeRefs?: Set<string>): { meta: IPropertyMetadata | undefined; bindingPath: string; propKey: string; };
    static toBindingPath(scope: string): string;
    static walk<TNode = IPropertyMetadata>(root: NoInfer<TNode> | ReadonlyArray<NoInfer<TNode>> | Partial<ISchema> | IPropertyMetadata | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined, visitor: SchemaVisitor<TNode>, options?: ISchemaWalkOptions<TNode>): void;
    static walkPaired<TNode = IPropertyMetadata, TOther = unknown>(root: NoInfer<TNode> | ReadonlyArray<NoInfer<TNode>> | Partial<ISchema> | IPropertyMetadata | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined, otherRoot: TOther | undefined, cursor: IPairCursor<TNode, TOther>, visitor: PairedSchemaVisitor<TNode, TOther>, options?: ISchemaWalkPairedOptions<TNode, TOther>): void;
  export const JsonPayloadShape: ITreeShape<unknown>;
  export const LayoutElementShape: ITreeShape<ILayoutElement>;
  export const RawRecordShape: ITreeShape<JsonRecord>;
  export const SchemaShape: ITreeShape<IPropertyMetadata>;
  export type ChildKind = "property" | "item" | "branch" | "additional" | "element";
  export type PairedSchemaVisitor<TNode = IPropertyMetadata, TOther = unknown> = (ctx: IPairedVisitContext<TNode, TOther>) => SchemaVisitorResult;
  export type SchemaVisitor<TNode = IPropertyMetadata> = (ctx: ISchemaVisitContext<TNode>) => SchemaVisitorResult;
  export type SchemaVisitorResult = void | "skip-subtree" | "stop";
  interface IPairCursor<TNode, TOther>
    stepAdditional?(other: TOther, childNode: TNode, parentNode: TNode): ReadonlyArray<{ key: string; value: TOther; }> | undefined;
    stepArray?(other: TOther, childNode: TNode, key: string): ReadonlyArray<{ key: string; value: TOther; }> | undefined;
    stepBranch?(other: TOther, branchKeyword: string, key: string, childNode: TNode): TOther | undefined;
    stepProperty(other: TOther, key: string, childNode: TNode): TOther | undefined;
  interface IPairedVisitContext<TNode = IPropertyMetadata, TOther = unknown> extends ISchemaVisitContext<TNode>
    readonly other: TOther | undefined;
    readonly parentOther: TOther | undefined;
    readonly replaceOther: (next: TOther | undefined) => void;
  interface ISchemaVisitContext<TNode = IPropertyMetadata>
    readonly bindingPath: string;
    readonly branchKeyword?: string;
    readonly depth: number;
    readonly isArrayItem: boolean;
    readonly key: string;
    readonly kind: ChildKind;
    readonly node: TNode;
    readonly parent: TNode | null;
    readonly rawNode: TNode;
    readonly scope: string;
  interface ISchemaWalkOptions<TNode = IPropertyMetadata>
    readonly activeNodes?: WeakSet<object>;
    readonly activeRefs?: Set<string>;
    readonly baseBindingPath?: string;
    readonly baseScope?: string;
    readonly definitions?: Record<string, ISchema | IPropertyMetadata>;
    readonly initialDepth?: number;
    readonly maxArrayItems?: number;
    readonly maxDepth?: number;
    readonly onInvalidProperty?: (key: string, rawValue: unknown, parent: TNode) => void;
    readonly onLeave?: (ctx: ISchemaVisitContext<TNode>) => void;
    readonly onTruncate?: (scope: string, reason: "depth" | "cycle", rawNode?: TNode, other?: unknown) => void;
    readonly resolveDynamicChildren?: (node: TNode, ctx: ISchemaVisitContext<TNode>) => Iterable<ITreeChild<TNode>> | undefined;
    readonly resolveRef?: (ref: string) => ISchema | IPropertyMetadata | undefined;
    readonly resolveRefs?: boolean;
    readonly shape?: ITreeShape<TNode>;
    readonly shouldVisitChild?: (child: TNode, key: string, parent: TNode, isArrayItem: boolean) => boolean;
    readonly silentTruncationLog?: boolean;
    readonly skipHidden?: boolean;
    readonly visitAdditionalProperties?: boolean;
    readonly visitCombinators?: boolean;
    readonly visitDefinitions?: boolean;
    readonly visitRoot?: boolean;
  interface ISchemaWalkPairedOptions<TNode = IPropertyMetadata, TOther = unknown> extends Omit<ISchemaWalkOptions<TNode>, "onLeave" | "resolveDynamicChildren">
    readonly activeOthers?: WeakSet<object>;
    readonly detectOtherCycles?: boolean;
    readonly onLeave?: (ctx: IPairedVisitContext<TNode, TOther>) => void;
    readonly resolveDynamicChildren?: (node: TNode, ctx: IPairedVisitContext<TNode, TOther>) => Iterable<ITreeChild<TNode>> | undefined;
  interface ITreeChild<TNode>
    readonly bindingSegment: string;
    readonly branchKeyword?: string;
    readonly key: string;
    readonly kind: ChildKind;
    readonly node: TNode;
    readonly scopeSegment: string;
  interface ITreeShape<TNode>
    children(node: TNode, options?: ISchemaWalkOptions<TNode>): Iterable<ITreeChild<TNode>>;
    isHidden?(node: TNode): boolean;
    readonly defaultMaxDepth: number;
    resolveRef?(node: TNode, scope: string, options: ISchemaWalkOptions<TNode> | undefined, definitions: Record<string, ISchema | IPropertyMetadata> | undefined, activeNodes: WeakSet<object>, activeRefs: Set<string>, addedNodes: object[], addedRefs: string[], onCycle: (scope: string) => void): TNode | null;
